2609.08115.title: Router Prior Bias: Preserving Base Routing Structure in MoE Post-Training
2609.08115.paper_summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) pretraining relies on an auxiliary load-balancing loss (LBL) to drive per-expert utilization toward uniformity. Post-training inherits a different situation: the base router already encodes non-uniform expert co-activation structure, which a re-imposed uniformity objective flattens away. We show that downstream performance depends instead on holding this inherited routing softly, a principle we term soft router anchoring, and instantiate it as Router Prior Bias (RPB), a training-time bias that pulls the router logits toward a prior read off the frozen base router while leaving the router itself trainable. On math post-training of Moonlight-16B-A3B, RPB attains 45.77 in-domain accuracy against 31.91 under re-applied LBL and 29.44 under unanchored fine-tuning, and retains more out-of-domain capability than either. The ordering against LBL reproduces on a second model family (Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base), and the advantage over LBL is resolvable on an independently sourced corpus. Anchors defined on the router weights, on its logits, or on its output distribution perform comparably with no consistent ordering, which places the effect in the softness of the constraint rather than in the particular prior RPB supplies. Retained community structure in the expert co-activation graph tracks these gains wherever the base router is non-uniform enough for communities to form, yet enforcing the same prior as a hard assignment preserves that structure while performance falls sharply. Community structure is therefore a footprint of soft anchoring rather than its source, and the practical lesson is that inherited routing should be held softly during post-training, since both flattening it toward uniformity and enforcing it absolutely carry a downstream cost. Our code will be released at https://github.com/naver-ai/rpb.
2609.08115.paper_summary_zh: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) 的預訓練依賴於輔助的負載平衡損失 (LBL)，以驅動每個專家的使用率朝向均勻性。訓練後的情況則有所不同：基礎路由器已經編碼了非均勻的專家共同激活結構，而重新施加的均勻性目標則將其壓平。我們顯示下游性能實際上依賴於柔性保持這種繼承的路由，這一原則我們稱之為柔性路由錨定，並將其具體化為路由器先驗偏差 (RPB)，這是一種訓練時的偏差，將路由器的邏輯拉向從凍結的基礎路由器讀取的先驗，同時保持路由器本身可訓練。在 Moonlight-16B-A3B 的數學後訓練中，RPB 在領域內準確率達到 45.77，相較於重新施加 LBL 的 31.91 和未錨定微調的 29.44，並且保留了比兩者更多的域外能力。對 LBL 的排序在第二個模型系列 (Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base) 上得以重現，並且在獨立來源的語料庫上可解決對 LBL 的優勢。基於路由器權重、其邏輯或其輸出分佈定義的錨點表現相似，且沒有一致的排序，這將效果放在約束的柔性上，而不是特定的先驗 RPB 所提供的。專家共同激活圖中的保留社群結構追蹤這些增益，無論基礎路由器是否足夠非均勻以形成社群，但將相同的先驗強制為硬性分配則保持了該結構，同時性能急劇下降。因此，社群結構是柔性錨定的足跡，而不是其來源，實際的教訓是，在後訓練期間應柔性保持繼承的路由，因為將其壓平至均勻性和絕對強制都會帶來下游成本。我們的代碼將在 https://github.com/naver-ai/rpb 發布。
